There are typically 5-7 people fishing on a public charter. Please see our private charter information if your group will be 6 or more people fishing. quotes.text: Awesome experience with my son. Captain Ceasar and Anthony had us on fish within 15 minutes of launching. The views were priceless and boat pristine. Ceasar was great explaining technique of getting into and staying in the fish. 16 years fishing experience on Lake Tahoe he knows it and all the spots and species. There were 8 people fishing and we all limited out in 2 hours. On the ride back Anthony had the fish cleaned and ready. We took our fish to McDuffs pub and they cooked them for family style meal for dinner reservation. Absolutely incredible meal! Will definitely book again with Captain Ceasar and Tahoe Sport Fishing.

This is my second fishing trip with Tahoe Sports Fishing, and there will be plenty more!!! Just a top notch charter company. Captain Sammy and his mate Spanky were just the best. This is my 2nd trip with Sammy, I made sure when I booked this trip that I could get him. He always finds the fish, is just so knowledgeable, works hard keeping the rods in the water, plus just an overall great guy to be with. We caught our limit in just over 2 hours, 27 Kokanee and 3 good size Lake Trout. I'll definitely be booking with TSF again and will request Sammy. Thanks Sammy for another great day on the lake, see you soon!

This was our third trip out with Zach and Ethan on the Prophet over the past 3 years. It was and continues to be a perfect day and time well spent. The memories are priceless and Zach and Ethan are both amazing individuals who are true professionals as well as two of the nicest people you will ever meet. I will continue my annual fishing trip with them as long as I can get into a boat. It is one of the best and most memorable times in my life. It is also time I spend with all of my family on our fishing trips that my family and children will always remember sharing with us.

Came to Lake Tahoe for a bachelor party. We did a lot of different cool stuff but this was by far the most fun. Our guides Zach and Ethan got along perfect with us and helped all 8 of us become fishermen (most of us had maybe done this once before). We caught our first one maybe 60 seconds after being set up and hit 40 in less than 90 minutes. Last hour we just enjoyed the views, got some great pictures, and had the most incredible sashimi ever. Highly recommend.

Have been going out with Tahoe Sport Fishing for the past 20 years when I come to my timeshare. I have never been disappointed. I love the fact that you can take your fresh catch to one of the local restaurants and have them prepare your fish. This last weekend was one of the best. Newly established Andrew and docklands, Nate were great.The weather was perfect and the fishing was fantastic. Love this outfit.

Another fantastic trip withTahoe Sport Fishing, thanks Capt Zack! From booking to day of experience, the entire experience was 1st class. Boats are clean and comfortable, the captain and crew know what they are doing to put you on the fish. 8 years in a row and looking forward to many more.
